backlash.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 일이 뜻한 바와 달리 순조롭게 이루어지지 않고 어려움을 겪음.
backlash.englishDescription: (figurative) A state in which things do not go smoothly and one faces difficulties against one's intention.

battleground.englishDescription: A place of a fight or battle.

canola.definitionKo: 잎과 줄기는 먹고 씨로는 기름을 짜는, 봄에 노란 꽃이 피는 식물.
canola.englishDescription: A plant whose yellow flowers bloom in spring, whose leaves and stem are eaten as food, and whose seeds are made into oil.

danja.definitionKo: 결혼이나 장례 의식 등에서 사용되는 태어난 연월일시나 이름 등을 쓴 종이.
danja.englishDescription: A piece of paper containing one's four pillars, namely the year, month, day, and hour of birth and one's name, which is used in a wedding, funeral, etc.

danja.definitionKo: 돈이나 물건을 보낼 때, 돈의 액수, 선물의 내용, 보내는 사람의 이름 등을 적은 종이.
danja.englishDescription: A piece of paper containing the amount of money, contents of the gift and the sender's name, which the sender encloses with a gift or money.

daringly.englishDescription: Although one feels scared or uncomfortable.
Confidently without feeling scared or uncomfortable.

gushingly.definitionKo: 많은 양의 액체가 급히 세차게 쏟아져 흐르는 소리.
gushingly.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a large amount of liquid pours and streams rapidly and strongly.
In the manner of a large amount of liquid brimming over.

left.definitionKo: 사람이 북쪽을 보고 있을 때 서쪽과 같은 쪽.

left.definitionKo: 사람이 북쪽을 보고 있을 때 서쪽과 같은 쪽.

madam.definitionKo: (높이는 말로) 신분이나 지위가 높은 집안의 부인.

madam.englishDescription: (polite form) A word used to refer to an aged person respectfully.

madam.englishDescription: An adult female adult in a group of unknown people. Or a word used to call that person.

manduso.definitionKo: 고기, 두부, 채소 등을 다져서 만드는, 만두 속에 넣는 재료.
manduso.englishDescription: The ingredients for mandu, dumpling, such as minced meat, tofu, vegetables, etc.

meticulous.englishDescription: One's personality or behavior being careful and scrupulous.

Free of glitches since one pays close attention to details.
Strict and thorough in one's personality.
One's behavior or personality being careful and composed.

meticulous.definitionKo: 행동, 태도 등이 꼼꼼하여 빈틈이 없다.

mishap.englishDescription: A sudden accident or strange happening.

nylon.definitionKo: 가볍고 질기며 피부에 닿는 느낌이 부드러운 합성 섬유.

run.definitionKo: 가지나 덩굴, 뿌리 등이 길게 자라나다. 또는 그렇게 하다.
